name: Salmon with Cauliflower Rice, Carrots, Beets & Cilantro-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium beets
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
6 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

While the beets are roasting, cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, garlic, green onion, and salt to the pot; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower rice is tender, 7-8 minutes. Cover and remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the cauliflower rice is cooking, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on another baking sheet; coat both sides with oil and season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add baking sheet to the oven and bake salmon until flesh is opaque and cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a blender (place remaining cilantro in the reserved bowl and set aside).

Peel additional garlic; add to the blender along with water, tahini, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1-2 tablespoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup water
¼ cup tahini
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the remaining cilantro.
Add cauliflower rice to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the cauliflower rice mixture between plates; top with roasted beets, salmon, and cilantro-tahini sauce. Enjoy!
